violations.description: Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. -Observed multiple items in refrigerators and walk in cooler that were not date marked.

General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. -Observed large chest freezer in pantry area has a damaged seal.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. -Observed vent hood over fryer needs to be cleaned.
Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. -Observed box of single service cups on floor behind bar.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)were not maintained in good repair. -Observed torn laminate on ceiling and torn vinyl on floor in food prep area.

General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. - Minor areas of repair needed to shelving/cabinets.
Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was reused or used more than one time. - Store boxes of single service items off floor in storage room.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. - Floors need cleaning under equipment, throughout kitchen, and along wall junctures.--Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. - Several ceiling tiles in dishwashing room in need of repair.
